notes.title: Patch 1.3 is now out! Are you ready for the end game?
notes.notes:
Greetings, Shifters! ✊
The time has come for the final major update in our post-launch journey, and we couldn’t be more excited to share it with you! 

This update brings the long-awaited, extremely challenging End Game Bosses—designed to test your skills and determination like never before.

We invite you to return to the game, take on these formidable foes, and show us what you’re made of. Whether you’re a seasoned veteran or coming back after a break, there’s never been a better moment to jump in and experience the ultimate challenge.

 
🐲 Changelog 1.3
Added Features: 

- Three end game bosses (very, very difficult) located in Scaptor cave in Aatma Valley, Houndra Lair in Nira Hills, outside Aasha. A guard appears near the city gate in Quilon telling you about this after you have completed the main story.

- Infinity arena challange called Trial of infinity. (Endless waves with increasing difficulty).

- Paddle tutorial in first part of rapids.

- Grab tutorial in cave passage in Riveredge mine.



Improvements: 

- Enabled players to create items with both a prime alterant and an alterant sequence.

- Increased energy cost of abilities.

- Balancing alterant sequences.


🐲 The road we've been on since launch
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40886702/8141f71a229fae90a92653a7fc0979088648a8b0.png"]

From the bottom of our hearts, thank you for being with us on this incredible adventure. Your passion, feedback, and support have meant the world to us. We couldn’t have done it without you.  

And, as always, please take a moment to leave a review. Your feedback is invaluable, and it would help us stand out! And, if you happen to encounter any bugs, please don't hesitate to let us know. We're actively engaging with our community on Discord, and you can also reach us via email at contact@aftnareld.com.

Last but not least, here's a short surprise from us - we took some funny videos from the development phase to show you, that sometimes, our job gave us not only a sweat - but a reason to have fun and smile, too!  Enjoy the bloopers reel!


[previewyoutube="SOVRdjFukJk;full"][/previewyoutube]
 

Follow us on Twitter/X, Instagram and join our Discord to stay in touch 🦖

See you in the game—and good luck with those bosses!

notes.title: Patch 1.2.9 is here – New Quest Guide System, Combat Improvements & More!
notes.notes:
Greetings, Shifters! 🌀

Today, we’re bringing you an update focused on Quality of Life improvements—many of which were directly requested by you, our amazing community. Patch 1.2.9 delivers a fresh wave of enhancements, bug fixes, and combat tweaks designed to make your journey through The World of Heera smoother, more intuitive, and even more enjoyable. Let’s dive into what’s new!

🐲 Changelog 1.2.9

Changes:

Grab Mechanic Overhaul: Enemies now have a chance to become “grabbable” for 4 seconds after being attacked (indicated by an icon). Use the grab button (default: "Interact" button) to grab them—charged attacks no longer grab
Waypoint Trackers Per Player: Each player now has their own tracker in multiplayer and can see others’ trackers
Tentacles now have a slower attack speed but can strike from slightly farther away
Mauling a grabbed enemy ("Interact" while grabbing) now restores a small amount of health even without specific skills
Removed the Explosive Slam skill from the Houndra skill tree
Alterant variants in a given X-series (e.g. FrX) now share a consistent alterant shape


Improvements:

New Quest Guide System: Tracked quests now show a yellow diamond icon on the map to guide you. NPCs with new quests are also marked
Melee Combat Improvements for Mouse + Keyboard: Better targeting and movement behavior while melee attacking, especially with the cursor close to the player
You can now remove a single unconfirmed point in the Skill and Beast Mastery tabs
Improved environment visuals through lighting and asset placement tweaks
Added air attacks for Scaptor and Ramox
Added slight camera zoom-out 
Made it more clear when a Perasin has already been collected
Improved code on the startup screen to reduce cases where players get stuck
Alterant sequences now display the required item tags and allow you to inspect individual alterants


Fixes:

Fixed an issue where the final boss didn’t reset properly after death
Fixed a bug that caused the quest tracker to appear far above its intended location
Map location discovery is now correctly saved and no longer resets when joining or rejoining a game
Lifted enemies (using the Lift Up skill) no longer collide awkwardly with the player
Various quest-related bugs have been resolved



⚠️ Important Notice:
Due to the changes in this update, any custom control remaps will be reset. Please rebind your preferred setup after updating.

We hope this update adds more fun to your experience. As always, we truly appreciate your continued support!

If you enjoy the update, don’t forget to leave a review—it helps Coridden grow! 💛
For bug reports or feedback, join us on Discord or contact us at: contact@aftnareld.com

Until next time, Shifters!
/Aftnareld Team 🦖

notes.title: Patch 1.2 is now out! Get ready for a New Game+
notes.notes:
Greetings, Shifters! ✊

We are thrilled to announce the release of our latest update, version 1.2, packed with new features and improvements based on your feedback!

New Game +
We’re so excited to share that a feature many of you have been asking for is finally coming to ​Coridden​ – New Game+! This new mode lets you dive back into the adventure with your existing character save file, keeping all your hard-earned progress and gear. To make things even more thrilling, enemies will be tougher with higher levels, and we’ve added a resistance penalty to increase the challenge even more!

🐲 Changelog 1.2
Added Features:
- New Game +: Replay with higher enemy levels and resistance penalty
- Max level increased to 80
- 2 more assignable skill slots, 6 skills can now be assigned on each form
- No helm and no creature accessory option in the cosmetics tab
- Transmog feature in the cosmetics tab
- Outline on/off option in the cosmetics tab
- New elemental weapons (both melee and ranged)
- Merchant that sells collars + creature ranged weapons in The Burrow
- "Transfer energy on mount" tutorial info into "Teleport to Creature" tutorial (will change this tutorial title to "Creature Mounts")
- New skill "Seeking Plasma" to energizer tab that cost a bit more energy than other skills but has a low cooldown
- New skill "Tempered Blood" to devotion tab that cast health to cast but has a low cooldown
- A button to cancel ability. Default: Right mouse button or B/ Circle on a controller (rebindable)
- An option to allow virtual player count to make it harder or easier for those who want it
- Camera Rotation Tutorial
- Supporter Pack DLC that includes: Color Picker, Pet companion: Droke, Gold Coating cosmetic, Footprints cosmetic "Titan steps", Footprints cosmetic "The benevolent"

You can read more about it here:
https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1656930/view/548983985537024795

Changes:
- Skill Balancing (old character save files will have unplaced points). Some skills have been moved to another tab and others have been placed in another tier. Cooldowns of some skills has been reduced. Damage numbers have been increased/decreased on some skills.
- Resistance alterant gives a higher bonus. Alterant with one resistance type has been increased from 15% to 30%, alterants with elemental or physical resistance has been increased from 7% to 10%.
- Ability power based Healing rate of healing zone has been reduced.
- Weapon damage is now multiplied when performing the Scaptor's Bane skill
- Weapon damage is now multiplied when performing the Summersault attack skill
- Charged pounce is now chargeable, it is also a melee attack when landing
- Stun chance + duration values have generally been decreased on weapons + alterants
- The cost of adding alterant spaces is dependent on the base level of the item
- A favorite marked item can no longer be sold (just unmark it if you want to sell it)
- You can now see the exact stats of a conjure when viewing a conjure skill
- Slightly increased XP penalty when fighting lower level enemies
- Some creature forms now deal elemental melee damage
- LB RB RT LT icons bigger text

Fixes/Improvements:
- Added icons that shows correct alterant shapes in the alterant sequence pages
- You can now pick up items from the back of a mount
- Added Xp meter next to portrait
- Fixed an issue that prevented beast mastery achievements to unlock when switching from the demo version to the real version
- The game now Autosave your character if dropping out of a local game
- Fixed a bug that made items get stuck in the air

🐲 What we are working on now
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40886702/0657526f7b2294187eb65b13e0f5f334011189c8.png

We hope these updates make your journey in Coridden even more enjoyable. Thank you for your continued support and feedback!

And if you haven't done that already, please take a moment to leave a review. Your feedback is invaluable, and it would help us stand out! And, if you happen to encounter any bugs, please don't hesitate to let us know. We're actively engaging with our community on Discord, and you can also reach us via email at contact@aftnareld.com.


Follow us on Twitter/X, Instagram and join our Discord to stay in touch 🦖

Until next time!
/Aftnareld Team

notes.title: Patch 1.0.4 is now out! Camera Rotation, Steam Deck and more
notes.notes:
Greetings, Shifters! ✊

We are thrilled to announce the release of our latest update, version 1.0.4, packed with exciting new features and improvements based on your feedback!

🐲 Camera Rotation: A Highly Requested Feature!
We have listened to your requests and are excited to introduce Camera Rotation! This new feature allows you to move your camera to get a better view of your character and minimize any obstructions from the environment during action sequences. This significant Quality of Life improvement required a lot of work, and we hope it enhances your gaming experience with Coridden!
Note: this is a very fresh function. If you stumble upon cases where this feature malfunctions, please let us know through Steam Discussions, Discord or via e-mail!

🐲 Officially "Playable" on Steam Deck!
We are proud to announce that Coridden has officially received the "Playable" status on Steam Deck! While the game was already playable, it now comes with the official check mark to confirm its compatibility. Here’s what you can expect:
🟢 All functionality is accessible when using the default controller configuration.
🟢 The game displays Steam Deck controller icons.
🟢 The default graphics configurations perform well on Steam Deck.
🟡 Some in-game text may be small and could be difficult to read.

🐲 Changelog 1.0.4
- Added feature: camera rotation
- Increase start available skill points, leveling up the first time gives you 3 extra skill points
- Fix bug that made stacks of alterants disappear when moving them from the stash to the inventory
- Fix bugs in forge
- Improve UX in forge
- Improved inventory sorting. Items of the same level are now sorted depending on type. Alterants are also sorted by required tags
- Added an option to sort items primarely by type and secondarily by level in the item options list
- Pilgrim quest fix
- Added rebindable input options, run towards cursor stop, and autorun forward
- Changed player light
- Improved game stability
- Increased text size on some texts and made the text scaling set to higher value if game started on Steam Deck

🐲 What we are working on now
- Multiplayer Optimization - Addressing disconnects in the Guard mission
- Arena Challenge
- Further Bug Fixes/Quality of Life improvements

We hope these updates make your journey in Coridden even more enjoyable. Thank you for your continued support and feedback!

And if you haven't done that already, please take a moment to leave a review. Your feedback is invaluable, and it would help us stand out! And, if you happen to encounter any bugs, please don't hesitate to let us know. We're actively engaging with our community on Discord, and you can also reach us via email at contact@aftnareld.com.

Follow us on Twitter/X, Instagram and join our Discord to stay in touch 🦖

Until next time!

notes.title: Patch 1.0.3 is now out!
notes.notes:
Greetings, Shifters! ✊

Patch 1.0.3 is now live! Let's see what's changed.

🐲 Changelog 1.0.3
🏃🏼‍➡️ General
- Added Item stacking to alterants and quest items!
- General game stability improvements
- Fix so PS glyphs are shown when using PS controller (turn off Steam Input)
- Fixed various localization issues
- Added text explaining that game needs to be started to host it
- Fixed issue with some Mouse controls resetting (remap)
🏃🏼‍➡️ Items & Skills
- Reduced prices on adding alterant space
- Adjusted balance on Conjuration skills (still work in progress)
- Fixed issue where Ira's Boom Bow gets downgraded from lvl 7 to 3 when travelling — it has now been changed to lvl 5
- Fixed issue with Vigorous skill reseting every time when changing zones, also added "Affects both forms" tag
- Made Marsh Crocolisk immune to toxic zone
- Fixed issue where Plated Roker droprate didn't work as intended
- Fixed issue where the explosion damage (for example in Blast Ranged Weapons) was not displayed correctly in stats (the contribution from the element attribute was not visible)
- Fixed bug where Vital force skill gave too much health back
- [strike]Fixed tag issue on "Shepherd" Alterant - it should now be possible to insert it into both armors and helmets[/strike] (still not working as intended - will revisit for next update)
- Updated credits
🏃🏼‍➡️ Areas & quests
- Worked on environment issues and improvements in Aasha area
- The dummies that are needed to be destroyed in Arena backstage are now highlighted
- Patched up a spot in Aatma Valley where you could get stuck
- Adjusted a current that could get player stuck in river, in Quilon Outskirts
- Added Map indication to Pryia's Headpiece
- Added an examinable text prompt hint where "Mounted Jump" is needed
- Corrected "heavy beast" in rock/wall destroying description to "ramming beast"
- Fixes so quest items can drop again if player loses them (affected quests: Stolen property, Egghunt, Missing Scavanger, Gamblers Stash, Supplies Retrieval)
- Fixed issue where you couldn't turn in Rapids Beast Q if defeated Crocolisk before getting quest
- Fixed issue where you couldn't turn in Coating Component Q during a certain phase in the story
- If both camps are killed in Bandit Rivalry Q, the quest will be marked as completed (but no reward is possible to collect, as no quest-givers are left alive!)
- Fixed so you can't talk to Najji before entering Aasha unlimited amount of times
- Fixed several perasins that didn't give an attribute point
- Fixed issue where you couldn't aim properly on electrical attackable objects for puzzels (such as the instance in Bandit Cave)
- Added some healing plants in towns
🏃🏼‍➡️ New savefile backup
We added a separate auto save system, that saves at regular intervals to a local only savefile with ending .dat1.
If you have issue with a save and want to try and recover an earlier version, remove the corrupted save and rename the save to .dat for it to appear in-game. You will probably be set back a little, but at least not loose all progress!

🐲 Known issue

notes.notes:

Patch 1.0.2 is now live! Let's see what's changed.

But before we do that, we'd like to thank you for taking the time to write your reviews! It's been a week since Coridden's launch, and we're currently standing proud with Very Positive reviews! We couldn't be happier to see how much you enjoy our game 😊 

And if you haven't done that already, please take a moment to leave a review. Your feedback is invaluable and it would help us stand out! And, if you happen to encounter any bugs, please don't hesitate to let us know. We're actively engaging with our community on Discord, and you can also reach us via email at contact@aftnareld.com.


Now, onto the changelog. These were all introduced based on the community feedback we received from you!

🐲 Changelog 1.0.2
- Added Controller Glyph override option
- Increased stash size by 50 slots
- Added Zoom in feature (rebindable)
- Added Credits in main menu
- Added confirmation on respec
- Added tutorial with all "Beast Specials" in tutorial list
- Show steam name next to character name
- Fixed issue with joining and using the search filter (incorrect password bug)
- Fixed Steam deck freeze in Aatma valley (still working on steamdeck optimization)
- Fix custom character glow menu bug
- Map scroll and rotation speed more equal (it had different speed depending on frame rate)
- Dual heavy wield now work with heavy swords
- Changed Fanatical Offering so it can hit flying enemies
- Toxic zone now makes it impossible to regenerate health
- Fixed an issue with Energy converter skill that made the resistance stack multiple times
- Fixed a bug with Iras Boom bow that made it deal more damage than expected when a barrier was active
- Increased the players base stagger protection and lowered the bonus from stabilization attribute (generally harder to get stunned)
- Lowered Roker Queens electric puddles damage
- Lower health on Ira in Roker Queen fight
- Made it possible to dodge projectiles
- Made it possible to dodge explosions if located far enough from the center
- Fixed a bug that could make it impossible to turn in the Rock blockade Quest

- Infected quest - updated the journal description
- Legendary champion quest - fixed issue that made it possible to talk to sister multiple times and get infinite reward

- More stable multiplayer
- More assignable skill slots
- Puzzle and quest clarifications
- Steam deck optimization
- Update demo for reactivation

notes.title: New creatures, class skills and procedural game mode - Dev Update #3 2022
notes.notes:
Greeting Shifters ✊🐲

As the last days of the year are approaching, we wanted to update you on the progress on Coridden! Since the latest demo period, we’ve been working a lot to improve the UX, UI and game feel - and we hope you’ll feel the differences in the upcoming demo updates.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40886702/a73db8c3cf9b6cb0d681e5ff591d72a5968c19a1.gif
New playable creature type: Demonhorn Ramox

We’ve also been working on the different game areas and adding and balancing items, with the aim towards reaching an alpha state of the game - where it's playable from start to finish with a fair amount of items and skills to try out.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40886702/c4e66dd89a4df17041b7c8955995d73c543b213a.gif
New playable creature type: Coral Panteliz

In addition to that, we’ve added a new type of challenge, called “Guard’s Missions”, that will let you go exploring procedurally generated areas with one of three increasingly difficult objectives to complete for various rewards.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40886702/aa54463e73f1ac6ab3322187f53a61f217f5ad22.gif
New playable creature type: Barkskin Dragolem

We hope to get the game out to your hands as soon as possible, but we want to make sure it’s as good as it can be - and we are super thankful to everyone who wants to contribute and help us to reach this goal by playtesting and giving us feedback! Follow to keep a lookout for when we have new versions to playtest available, or join our discord to get notified there.

Wishing you all happy holidays and great new year, we’re looking forward to showing you much more of Coridden in 2023!

notes.title: Double energy bars and various VFX + combat upgrades - Dev Update #2 2022
notes.notes:
Hey all, here is another update from the devs!

First we wanted to mention that tomorrow we’re doing a live stream where you can ask any questions you may have, discuss future plans with us or simply chat! We’d be thrilled if you’d like to join us on tomorrow (Monday 11th of April) 21.00 CEST at our channel https://www.twitch.tv/aftnareld 

Lately we’ve been taking in a lot of feedback and using it to try to improve and polish the gameplay.
We’ve mainly been doing a lot of smaller fixes and upgrades, but one big design change we decided to implement is that you now have two energy bars: one for your human form and one for your beast form. Both melee and ranged attacks now cost energy, with melee attack damage being significantly reduced if you’re out of energy. This will give you a good reason to use, equip and upgrade both your human and melee form, making the combat more interesting and varied!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40886702/0783bd313b72b160528b6cdc8fe1d109cef1fdc9.gif
New feature: two energy bars

Some other things we’ve been working on:

 Making movement look and feel more smooth and responsive
 Improving VFX, primarily the different elemental damage type attacks
 Make it easier to navigate and polished up some demo levels
 Improving UX, mainly for Class selection and Player health/energy bars
 Changed up the horde mode in the demo, so you now face more varied enemy waves
 Added new item slot: Creature Accessory (only affecting stats)
 Improving loot drops modifications so it is possible to receive a greater variety of randomized items with higher rarities (highest chance to see these items is to play the horde mode)


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40886702/b5b562a9448ece71bfcd5eeda2ecda81626b12a1.gif
New heat/fire damage weapon VFX

notes.title: Beast masteries, new animations and more - Dev Update #1 2022
notes.notes:
Hey creatures of all kind!

We’ve really gotten up to speed again after the holiday break in January, and as the short month of February is coming to an end, I wanted to write about some of the things we’ve been working on lately:

To make our world feel more alive and lively, we’ve animated the people in town. Now they’re talking, walking and overall having a more exciting life than before. Also, we’ve been working on another friendly creature that you’ll be able to see flying around in town later on.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40886702/f672f19ec98a85f9072c2f67a74a325bd9558fc7.gif

We’ve been continuing working on making the combat feel and look better, polishing animations, control and effects. The difference between light and heavy (charged) attack should be more apparent now! Also we added health drops from enemies, as it was requested by many to have more ways to get health back.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40886702/9e090b172a6e0a5685f4b715f36eb3ed99adf8de.gif

We’ve added a new little teaser in the form of a “coming soon” tab in the character menu, namely the “Beast Mastery” tab (name not final). Here you will be able to upgrade your different creature forms with new bonuses, skills etc. as you level them up. Hope you’re as excited for this one as we are!

notes.title: The Big but Short 2021 Update!
notes.notes:
This year is coming to an end, and we wanted to take the time to summarise what we’ve been working on this year since the demo week last summer! (If you’ve read the weekly updates on our discord server then this may not be much news, but more of a recap.) 

We have an updated playable demo available early to our Discord community, so if you want to try it out during the holidays, go ahead and download it there! 

We could write a whole page of what we’ve been up to, but we don’t want to drag things out walls of text... So here is a list of some things we’ve been working on instead:

 Added 2 new creature variations
 Worked on levels and quests for the main story line
 New environments (also updates to environments in demo)
 Updated character models
 Updated animations
 Added new melee weapon categories for humans: heavy weapons & dual wield 
 New music
 Remap system (still early version)
 Various UI/UX updates (this is something we are going to work even more on early next year!)
 Design and implementation of classes and skills. They are very much still under development, but you can try out a limited portion in the latest demo!

So what's to come for 2022? Our current plan is to have a Kickstarter campaign early next spring, as we decided to push it forward to make a better demo before we ask anyone to pledge to our campaign - we want to put out something great for you to play and show our commitment to this project! And we want to of course continue adding more content and polish into the game, working on story, quests, UI and UX, classes, skills, items, levels, creatures… The list goes on ;) We’re going to publish an approximate roadmap for you at the latest during the Kickstarter campaign. 

We’re still in a stage where we are able to change a lot of things, so if you want to help us and make an impact on the game - don’t hesitate to let us know what you like and don’t like! 

Have a wonderful holiday, wishing you all a merry christmas and a happy new year.
Hope you are as excited as we are for what's to come for Coridden in 2022!
